purpose: Identify songs actually derived from real Luna Codex draws. Rune imagery alone is insufficient.
definition: rune_song = a song whose creative provenance explicitly includes a real rune draw result that was interpreted and then extended into lyrics/song.

classification.confirmed: Direct source record explicitly links a real draw to the song.
classification.high_candidate: Strong multi-source match such as same date plus exact drawn-rune title, but missing explicit creation provenance.
classification.medium_candidate: Temporal/contextual match to a known draw, but no direct rune linkage.
classification.author_recalled: Author recalls that rune songs were created using OW3gs 11-card draws, and identifies these candidates as likely belonging to that process. Stronger than metadata inference, but still distinct from a preserved original draw-to-song record.

rules: Do not classify a song as rune_song solely because its title or lyrics contain rune, moon, fate, shadow, light or similar motifs.
Do not classify by semantic similarity alone.
Confirmed records require an explicit draw-to-song provenance source.
Candidates remain separate from confirmed rune songs.

dataset_pipeline.note: Future dataset rebuilds preserve any explicit rune/draw provenance that actually exists in the source workbook instead of dropping it.

next_confirmation_rule: When a rebuilt LOC3 work contains explicit rune_provenance linking a real draw to the song, promote the corresponding candidate to confirmed after source review.

confirmation_policy.confirmed: Explicit author confirmation or preserved original draw-to-song record.
confirmation_policy.author_recalled: Author identifies the work as likely rune-song output from the known OW3gs workflow, but expresses uncertainty.

recovery_status.note: Do not treat the current three confirmed records as the full rune-song corpus.
